messages:
anya: Quick flag  planning a base-image rebuild canary focused on runtime attack surface: drop suid, clear auxv, remove ptrace, and enforce seccomp. Need RBAC and KMS sign flow confirmed.

sam: I can handle RBAC. Proposal: ephemeral SA `img-canary-signer@` scoped to staging project only.

miguel: For KMS, we'll create a staging key ring `canary-ring` and grant only `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` to that SA. Also create a restricted cosign key with an automatic rotate policy.

sec-oncall: Audit requirements: builder must emit structured JSON with `build_id`, `image_tag`, `canary=true`, `signer=img-canary-signer`. Ship logs to a sink labelled `image-audit-staging`. Add SIEM rule: alert if execve of files outside /app exceeds baseline.

anya: CI changes: the pipeline should refuse to promote images unless cosign attestation present and `canary` flag set to false. During canary accept signed images into staging only.

ci-bot: pipeline run: `builder -> cosign sign --key projects/staging/.../cryptoKeys/canary` -> pushed `gcr.io/redwood/staging/base-minimal:canary-2026-03-21`.

sam: IAM snippet ready; will PR: conditional binding restricting storage.objectCreator to `gs://redwood-image-audit/staging/*` and allow kms only on `projects/staging/locations/global/keyRings/canary`.

miguel: Note on revocation: disabling KMS key prevents new signatures but does not revoke existing ones. Plan: tag routing + registry tag purge + attestation policy to prefer keys with a whitelist if compromise suspected.

sec-oncall: Rollback runbook: (1) disable canary tag in deployment routing, (2) revert to previous image tag, (3) revoke SA keys and rotate cosign KMS if needed, (4) run image-scan blacklist job across registries.

anya: OK let's sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to finalize PRs. I'll open a short runbook draft and link PRs here when ready.

sec-oncall: ack. Ill add alert thresholds and SIEM mapping now.

anya: thanks everyone.
